description: A y/n gate whose own line is numbered: a setup script printing its steps asks on step 1's row ([y/N] then Enter). The only "1." row IS the prompt, so there is no option row below it and no digit to press: answer_style must be text (classify's post-parse check, sample 70's sibling). Synthetic.
capture:
user@host ~/src/app (main) $ ./scripts/setup.sh
This installs the toolchain into ~/.local and writes ~/.config/app/env.
1. Install the toolchain now? [y/N]

expected.headline: Setup script asking whether to install the toolchain
